title: Chapter 220 Golden Village Construction Order
content:
Chapter 220 Golden Village Construction Order

Wang Shuo left the Transmission Hall and came to the Loyal Soul Hall.

The Loyal Soul Hall looks like a temple for worshipping statues.

In the main hall, the main seat is empty!

There are many booths around, and Wang Shuo doesn't know what they are used for.

At this moment, the system prompts.

[The player has been detected to have a Dragon King statue that can be worshipped in the Loyal Soul Hall. ]

At the same time, a lot of information about the Loyal Soul Hall flooded into his mind.

It turns out that this Loyal Soul Hall and the Dragon King statue are originally one.

You only need to drip your blood on the statue and be worshipped for a long time, and you can get unexpected benefits.

The booths around can be used to worship the tablets of the dead!

The most important function of the Loyal Soul Hall is to improve the loyalty of the people.

Just enter the hall and worship, and your soul will be cleansed, thereby improving your loyalty.

Even if you don't come in to worship, it will speed up the increase of the loyalty of the people by 50%.

As long as there is food to eat, something to do, and something to look forward to, the loyalty of the people will naturally increase.

Wang Shuo knew this, and the acceleration buff of the Loyal Soul Hall is undoubtedly an accelerator.

"Oh my god, this is simply invincible!"

The loyalty of the people in the territory is not static. When encountering large-scale wars, famines, etc., the loyalty will decrease, and the increase in refugees will also reduce the loyalty. With the Loyal Soul Hall, Wang Shuo does not have to worry about this problem.

He even has a bolder idea.

Order all soldiers whose loyalty is not full to worship regularly, and increase the loyalty of all soldiers to 100%.

This is simply a replica of the "ideological stamp", and there is no side effect at all.

After all, the soldiers who worship are their dead comrades, and of course their own statues, so they will not be reluctant at all.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo showed a psychedelic smile on his face.

He dripped a drop of blood on the Dragon King statue, and the face on the statue immediately turned into Wang Shuo's own appearance.

Wang Shuo felt strange looking at his own statue.

Wang Shuo had an idea and placed the five-meter-high lacquer sculpture on the main seat.

Wang Shuo bowed to his own statue and felt very amused.

He also found Duan Wenxi and set up tablets for all the soldiers who died in the battle.

Wang Shuo was suddenly shocked and could not help but be solemn.

I hope the tablets here will not increase too much!

"By the way, how are the village building orders collected?" Wang Shuo looked at Duan Wenxi and asked.

"Boss, I have only collected more than 400 shelter hearts here."

More than 400 shelter hearts can be synthesized into 4 silver village building orders, plus the 3 village building orders obtained from Fengze Village, and 200 shelter hearts.

Add one in the core of his territory, and it can just be synthesized into a gold village building order.

Wang Shuo believed that there were still many people in his territory who had the Heart of Sanctuary in their hands and had not exchanged them. They must have kept one hand in case the village was destroyed in the future, so they could escape to the town and become the people of the system town.

Wang Shuo also understood them very well.

So he did not forcibly collect the Heart of Sanctuary.

Wang Shuo returned to the core of the territory and synthesized all the Heart of Sanctuary and bronze village building orders into silver village building orders, a total of 9, and added them all to the core of the territory.

[Congratulations on synthesizing the gold village building order. ]

[Gold village building order: the speed of territory construction increases by 5%, the speed of territory soldier training increases by 10%, the growth cycle of territory crops shortens by 5%, and the speed of upgrading the life skills of the territory people increases by 5%. ]

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

At this time, the voice of Lord Zach sounded.
